text: 📈 Monday data: Damming the slop floods Exponential View Subscribe Sign in 📈 Monday data: Damming the slop floods AI makes content cheap. Who pays to make it trustworthy? Azeem Azhar , Hannah Petrovic , and Marija Gavrilov Sep 28, 2026 ∙ Paid 49 1 8 Share There’s a flood of AI content coming down the pipeline across all forms of media. Music, images, LinkedIn posts , longform, and book summaries. As AI output grows, the question becomes: what does a future coexistence with AI-generated content look like? The growth of websites made by AI has been noticeable since 2023. Now every third webpage created has some part attributable to AI . Press releases, expected to be a trustworthy source of information, hit an all-time high of nearly a 50% chance of containing AI-generated text in June this year — doubling within a year.
